title: World Baseball Classic 2026
metaDescription: The 2026 World Baseball Classic ran from 5 to 17 March, with the championship round staged in Miami.

overview.about: The World Baseball Classic is the sport's premier international tournament, pitting national teams - stocked with Major League stars - against each other in a World Cup-style event. It has done more than anything to grow baseball's global profile. Japan are the most successful nation with three titles. The 2027 final stage is in Miami, 5-17 March.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 World Baseball Classic culminates in Miami in March, with the knockout rounds and final at loanDepot Park. Twenty teams take part across host venues in Asia and the Americas before the champion is crowned.
